items.claim: The cut at oshb:Jer.46.27 and the salvation_oracle typing are warranted by an explicit addressee and outcome shift - Jacob and Israel comforted with a return promise, replacing the judgment just pronounced on Egypt - inside the header-bounded Egypt unit, with the operative-category deviation disclosed and the closing setumah at oshb:Jer.46.28 correctly treated as corroboration rather than the driver for the return to a fresh nations-header at oshb:Jer.47.1.
items.evidence: Both verses' WEB text match the folded verse data exactly at web:Jer.46.27 and web:Jer.46.28; the setumah marks at oshb:Jer.46.26 and oshb:Jer.46.28 are both confirmed in the marked-verse inventory as single-witness, tier-3 entries; the full-end contrast between the nations and Jacob that the row cites sits within oshb:Jer.46.28 itself; the next fresh nations-header at oshb:Jer.47.1 is accurately identified as outside this row's span.

items.claim: The header-plus-vision unit correctly withholds a cut at the koh-amar in oshb:Jer.47.2 because that formula is the frame's own first speech rather than a change of frame-owner, and the row's close before the hoy onset at oshb:Jer.47.6 is properly warranted with the setumah at oshb:Jer.47.5 disclosed as corroboration only.
items.evidence: All five verses' WEB text match the folded verse data exactly at web:Jer.47.1 through web:Jer.47.5, including the footnote-bearing form at the neighboring oshb:Jer.48.1 header quoted for forward context, where the bracketed footnote is correctly absent from the quoted form; the asher-hayah debar-YHWH el-Yirmeyahu header shape at oshb:Jer.47.1 matches its inventoried four-site class; the paseq at oshb:Jer.47.2 is disclosed count-only, matching the seg inventory.

items.claim: The hoy at oshb:Jer.47.6 is correctly typed as the sword-apostrophe shape rather than a woe-onset or funeral-cry shape, and the unit is properly bounded by that onset and the fresh lamed-header opening the Moab oracle at oshb:Jer.48.1, with the closing setumah at oshb:Jer.47.7 disclosed as corroboration only.
items.evidence: Both verses' WEB text match the folded verse data exactly at web:Jer.47.6 and web:Jer.47.7; the sword-apostrophe role-typing matches the hoy role-split inventory, which lists oshb:Jer.47.6 in its own shape-class apart from the woe-onset sites; the setumah at oshb:Jer.47.7 is confirmed in the marked-verse inventory as single-witness.

items.claim: The lamed-header unit is correctly bounded from oshb:Jer.48.1 through oshb:Jer.48.8, with the woe folded inside the header verse itself disclosed as a distinct shape from a bare or vav-prefixed woe onset, the divine-title stack sweep citation accurately matching its inventoried count, and the ketiv/qere content at the doubled-note site oshb:Jer.48.7 correctly reported without an inflated ordinal claim.
items.evidence: All eight verses' WEB text match the folded verse data exactly, including the footnote-stripped form at web:Jer.48.1; the YHWH-tsevaot-Elohei-Yisrael stack sweep of 32 verses matches the divine-name inventory; oshb:Jer.48.7's two ketiv/qere pairs and its membership in the twelve doubled-note verses both check against the marked-verse inventory, and the row states its membership without claiming a false ordinal position.

items.claim: The front-seam warrant at oshb:Jer.48.9 rests on a discourse imperative introducing a fresh figure, but the immediately preceding imperative at oshb:Jer.48.6 shares the identical shape - a plural command with Moab named only in the third person and no second-person vocative - and was held inside the prior unit on exactly that no-named-addressee ground, so the row does not reconcile why one bare imperative opens a fresh unit while the structurally identical other does not.
items.evidence: oshb:Jer.48.6 and oshb:Jer.48.9 are both plural imperative onsets with no vocative addressee named in either verse, Moab referenced only in the third person in both; no parashah mark, koh-amar, hoy, date-formula, or word-event header falls at the oshb:Jer.48.8/oshb:Jer.48.9 seam to supply an independent tier-1 signal beyond the imperative itself, and the row's own rejected alternative addresses only a later internal split at oshb:Jer.48.11/oshb:Jer.48.12, not this front boundary.

items.claim: The unit correctly resists cutting at the melekh-signature close in oshb:Jer.48.15 because no fresh tier-1 onset follows at oshb:Jer.48.16, properly applying the closure-corroboration-only rule, and the ordinal placement of this melekh-signature site as the second of the three sites carrying the construction is accurate and digit-anchored.
items.evidence: All three verses' WEB text match the folded verse data exactly at web:Jer.48.14 through web:Jer.48.16; the melekh-signature construction's three-site sweep and oshb:Jer.46.18 as the earlier of the two prior sites cited both match the neum-stack inventory; oshb:Jer.48.16 opens with no divine-speech formula, woe, or direct address, confirming the absence of a fresh tier-1 onset; confidence is honestly held at medium_low with the frontier flag disclosed for the genuinely unmarked attachment of oshb:Jer.48.16.

items.claim: The row misstates oshb:Jer.48.20's position in the book's doubled ketiv/qere inventory as the second such site, when ordered through the book it is the eighth of the twelve doubled-note verses.
items.evidence: The marked-verse inventory's twelve doubled-note sites in book order are oshb:Jer.3.19, oshb:Jer.4.19, oshb:Jer.6.25, oshb:Jer.13.20, oshb:Jer.14.14, oshb:Jer.22.23, oshb:Jer.48.7, oshb:Jer.48.20, oshb:Jer.49.39, oshb:Jer.50.6, oshb:Jer.50.11, oshb:Jer.51.34; oshb:Jer.48.20 is the eighth entry in that sequence, not the second, though its own doubled count of two ketiv/qere notes and its accompanying paseq are both independently confirmed against the same inventory.

items.claim: The bare town-list unit is correctly bounded through the neum-YHWH close at oshb:Jer.48.25, using the form-shift into a fresh imperative scene with its own figure at oshb:Jer.48.26 as an independent second ground alongside closure-corroboration, rather than letting the formula alone drive the boundary.
items.evidence: All five verses' WEB text match the folded verse data exactly at web:Jer.48.21 through web:Jer.48.25, including the ketiv/qere-bearing form at oshb:Jer.48.21; the town-list's repeated-conjunction form and its near-zero poetry-line texture across oshb:Jer.48.21-Jer.48.24 match the folded verse data; the neum-YHWH close at oshb:Jer.48.25 is correctly treated as corroboration rather than sole driver, since a fresh discourse-imperative figure opens immediately after at oshb:Jer.48.26.
